H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H241: broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man)
H995: to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H5307: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H3198: to be right (i.e. correct); reciprocal, to argue; causatively, to decide, justify or convict
H410: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
H2654: properly, to incline to; by implication (literally but rarely) to bend; figuratively, to be pleased with, desire
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H2950: properly, to stick on as apatch; figuratively, to impute falsely
H8267: an untruth; by implication, a sham (often adverbial)
H7495: properly, to mend (by stitching), i.e. (figuratively) to cure
H457: good for nothing, by anal. vain or vanity; specifically an idol
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H2790: to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to engrave, plough; hence (from the use of tools) to fabricate (of any material); figuratively, to devise (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be silent, to let alone; hence (by implication) to be deaf (as an accompaniment of dumbness)
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H4994: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
H8433: chastisement; figuratively (by words) correction, refutation, proof (even in defence)
H8193: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.)
H7181: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H5375: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H7378: properly, to toss, i.e. grapple; mostly figuratively, to wrangle, i.e. hold a controversy; (by implication) to defend
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H2713: properly, to penetrate; hence, to examine intimately
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H2048: to deride; by implication, to cheat
H582: a man in general (singly or collectively)
H5643: a cover (in a good or a bad, a literal or a figurative sense)
H7613: an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively, elation or cheerfulness; exaltation in rank or character
H6343: a (sudden) alarm (properly, the object feared, by implication, the feeling)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H2146: a memento (or memorable thing, day or writing)
H4912: properly, a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature; hence, a simile (as an adage, poem, discourse)
H1354: the back (as rounded); by analogy, the top or rim, a boss, a vault, arch of eye, bulwarks, etc.
H2563: properly, a bubbling up, i.e. of water, a wave; of earth, mire or clay (cement); also a heap; hence, a chomer or dry measure
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H1320: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of aman
H8127: a tooth (as sharp); specifically ivory; figuratively, a cliff
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
H3709: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power
H6991: properly, to cut off, i.e. (figuratively) put to death
H3176: to wait; by implication, to be patient, hope
H389: a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H3444: something saved, i.e. (abstractly) deliverance; hence, aid, victory, prosperity
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H4405: a word; collectively, a discourse; figuratively, a topic
H6186: to set in a row, i.e. arrange, put in order (in a very wide variety of applications)
H4941: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
H6663: to be (causatively, make) right (in a moral or forensic sense)
H6258: at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive
H1478: to breathe out, i.e. (by implication) expire
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H227: at that time or place; also as a conjunction, therefore
H5641: to hide (by covering), literally or figuratively
H7368: to widen (in any direction), i.e. (intransitively) recede or (transitively) remove (literally or figuratively, of place or relation)
H367: fright; concrete, an idol (as a bugbear)
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H6030: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
H176: desire (and so probably in Proverbs 31:4); hence (by way of alternative) or, also if
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H2403: an offence (sometimes habitual sinfulness), and its penalty, occasion, sacrifice, or expiation; also (concretely) an offender
H2803: properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute
H5929: a leaf (as coming up on a tree); collectively, foliage
H6206: to awe or (intransitive) to dread; hence, to harass
H7291: to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by)
H3789: to grave, by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe)
H4846: properly, bitterness; concretely, a bitter thing; specifically bile; also venom (of a serpent)
H3423: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants, and possessing in their place); by implication, to seize, to rob, to inherit; also to expel, to impoverish, to ruin
H5271: (only in plural collectively or emphatic form) youth, the state (juvenility) or the persons (young people)
H7272: a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphemistically the pudenda
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H734: a well-trodden road (literally or figuratively); also a caravan
H2707: to carve; by implication, to delineate; also to entrench
H1086: to fail; by implication to wear out, decay (causatively, consume, spend)
H899: a covering, i.e. clothing; also treachery or pillage
